title: Lastonia Leviston: From Scandal to Strength
htmlContent:
The Netflix Series That Brings the Spotlight Back

The new Netflix series W.A.G.s to Riches features an inspiring story from Lastonia "Stoni" Leviston. Leviston's story is a testament to resilience, heartbreak, and empowerment, influenced by her ties to rapper Rick Ross and her tumultuous history. The show began on January 22, 2025, and examines the lives of women who have had relationships with celebrities and athletes. Still, Leviston's journey is particularly noteworthy because it demonstrates the power of perseverance.

A Scandal That Shook Her World

Leviston became widely known in the early 2010s after a private sex tape was leaked online. Her ex-partner, rapper 50 Cent, was involved in the incident, which furthered the longstanding feud between 50 Cent and Rick Ross. In the series' first episode, Leviston reflects on this painful chapter, admitting that it still haunts her. "I was collateral damage in a feud I had nothing to do with," Leviston tearfully shared, recalling how the incident took an emotional toll on her life.

Life as Rick Ross’s Ex and Single Motherhood

Leviston openly discussed her previous relationship with Rick Ross, revealing the intricacies of their dynamic. "My baby daddy is Rick Ross. Our daughter is 22 years old," Leviston shared. She left Ross when their daughter was just two years old. Despite their separation, Leviston remains tied to him, living in a house he owns. "I feel like I’m in a luxury prison," she confided, highlighting the challenges of moving forward.

The Sex Tape Scandal: A Painful Chapter

Leviston recounted how her former boyfriend, Maurice Murray, secretly recorded their intimate moments. Although she trusted him at first, their relationship turned sour when he started cheating. Their breakup coincided with the feud between Rick Ross and 50 Cent. Murray allegedly sold the tape to 50 Cent, who altered it and released it online in 2009 as an act of betrayal. Leviston was deeply sad, describing it as a moment that had a lasting effect on her life. "I became suicidal. I didn’t want to live anymore," Leviston admitted. The lawsuit she filed against 50 Cent in 2010 led to a $5 million settlement. 50 Cent was held accountable and the emotional impact of revenge porn was brought to light by the case.

Building Strength Amid Judgment

Leviston has demonstrated remarkable resilience despite public scrutiny and personal pain. As a member of the cast of W.A.G.s to Riches, she's striving to reinvent her narrative and reveal women's obstacles in the public eye. "This friend group can be extremely judge," Leviston noted, referring to her classmates, who include women like Sharelle Rosado and Ashley Wheeler.

Redefining "W.A.G.s" Through Empowerment

In W.A.G.s to Riches, nine influential women are shown navigating relationships, careers, and social expectations. Leviston sees this as an opportunity to regain her story and inspire others. The series challenges the stereotype that women are associated with athletes and celebrities, demonstrating their strength and ambition.

Streaming Now on Netflix

Leviston's journey is a powerful symbol of perseverance and redemption. Anyone facing adversity can find hope in her candid reflections on pain, healing, and growth. Watch W.A.G.s to Riches, now available on Netflix, and witness how these women turn challenges into victories.
